svg.title: RiNGSiDE: tool calling, score against round time
svg.desc: RiNGSiDE tool calling with SeraphimSerapis/tool-eval-bench 2.7.1.dev7+gbd35ba91b, 92 scenarios per round, lab review snapshot 2026-09-27 01:04 (UTC+7), local draft. TP4: RiNGSiDE High 91 (89–92) in 6:22 (6:20–6:35), Low 88 (85–88) in 4:52 (4:41–5:02), Max 93 in 9:27; MiaAI-Lab/GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3-2x-DGX-Sparks High 90 (88–91) in 11:11 (10:36–11:16), Low 88 (86–90) in 8:02 (7:59–8:26), Max 92 in 15:03. TP2: RiNGSiDE High 90 (89–92) in 13:52 (12:56–13:54), Low 89 (86–89) in 11:04 (11:04–11:30), Max 92 in 20:00; MiaAI-Lab/GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3-2x-DGX-Sparks High 90 (90–92) in 16:49 (16:13–17:09), Low 88 (88–89) in 11:49 (11:38–11:55), Max 90 in 21:48. RiNGSiDE High with more scenarios in parallel: TP4 at 8 90 (86–91), TP4 at 16 91 (89–92), TP2 at 8 93 (90–95).
svg.text: RiNGSiDE: tool calling, score against round time
TP4 blue: plan 92817b8d (release + A1e). TP2 orange: release plan b80911ec.
RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 @ 18d55bfd · measured lab image 017fd0ba; public rebuild unqualified.
Hollow grey: commit 70b2f332, clean build. TP4 lab adaptation: compact KV off, K4. TP2: compact KV, K7.
92 scenarios (69 core + 23 Hard Mode (--hardmode)) · one trial per round · thinking on · 4 scenarios in parallel
temperature 0 · seed 42 · top_p 1 · top_k -1 · min_p 0 · repetition penalty 1
max turns 8 · timeout 300 s · reference date 2026-09-26
Output ceiling per turn: 16,384 tokens (High, Low) · 32,768 tokens (Max)

svg.text: Every round: score and round time, with median and range
rounds in run order; median (min–max) only for complete cohorts · 4 scenarios in parallel
Round time covers one 92-scenario round. Model boot, preparation, hardware queue waits and admission probes are excluded.
Recipes differ in quantization, runtime and speculative settings. These are complete-recipe comparisons.
Observed score range within a complete cohort: up to 5 points.
Reported output-limit truncation: RiNGSiDE TP4 High, 16 in parallel, round 2 (TC-88).
Per-turn finish reasons are not fully retained; absence of a report does not prove absence of truncation.
Pending rounds are labelled, never estimated. Greedy and sampled cohorts remain separate.
Receipts: bench/results/tool-eval-logs · result.json, report and console per round · SHA-256 in manifest.json
Renderer: bench/results/tool_eval_chart.py · complete settings and recipe provenance in tool-eval-current.md
